_documentation.purpose: Defines the reusable simulation named 'NbN illustrative electron-phonon hotspot'.
_documentation.relies_on: Loaded by a simulation or experiment configuration; packaged defaults fill only omitted optional simulation controls.
_documentation.run_command: Not run directly; reference this filename from a simulation or tool configuration.
_documentation.authority: Values in this file are authoritative for its runner. A sweep value overrides the corresponding base-simulation value only for that named case; effective values are recorded in summary.json.

fields.name: Human-readable identifier.
fields.geometry: Geometry JSON filename loaded from configs/geometry.
fields.material: Material JSON filename or material-property object.
fields.thermal.bath_temperature: Thermal-reservoir temperature toward which the film relaxes.
fields.thermal.model: Selects a single film temperature or separate electron and phonon temperatures.
fields.thermal.electron_heat_capacity_fraction: Fraction of the material heat capacity assigned to electrons; the remainder is assigned to phonons.
fields.thermal.electron_thermal_conductivity_fr: Fraction of the material thermal conductivity assigned to electrons; the remainder is assigned to phonons.
fields.thermal.electron_phonon_coupling_W_m3_K: Linear electron-to-phonon energy-transfer coefficient in watts per cubic metre per kelvin.
fields.thermal.phonon_escape_rate_per_s: Rate at which film phonons relax toward the substrate bath; inverse seconds.
fields.thermal.stability_safety_factor: Safety margin used when choosing an explicit stable timestep.
fields.electrical.normal_conductivity_model: Selects how normal-carrier conductivity varies with superconducting state and temperature.
fields.electrical.voltage_left: Potential imposed at the left transport boundary.
fields.electrical.voltage_right: Potential imposed at the right transport boundary.
fields.electrical.solver.backend: Selects the numerical implementation for this solver component.
fields.electrical.solver.tolerance: Numerical or physical acceptance tolerance for tolerance.
fields.electrical.solver.omega: Successive-over-relaxation weight for the iterative solve.
fields.tdgl.normalization: Selects the dimensional scaling used by the TDGL equation.
fields.tdgl.temperature_model: Selects how temperature modifies the TDGL coefficients.
fields.tdgl.gamma: Generalized TDGL inelastic-relaxation parameter; zero selects the simpler gapless form.
fields.tdgl.stability_safety_factor: Safety margin used when choosing an explicit stable timestep.
fields.tdgl.time_integrator: Euler is first order; Heun uses a gauge-compatible predictor-corrector for improved small-step TDGL accuracy.
fields.coupling.tolerance: Numerical or physical acceptance tolerance for tolerance.
fields.coupling.prediction_window: Recent residual values used to estimate convergence behavior.
fields.coupling.reasonable_iterations: Iteration count treated as acceptable when scoring a benchmark.
fields.coupling.fast_ratio: Residual-reduction ratio below which convergence is fast.
fields.coupling.healthy_ratio: Residual-reduction ratio below which convergence is healthy.
fields.coupling.stall_ratio: Residual-reduction ratio above which progress is stalled.
fields.coupling.oscillation_window: Residual-history length used to detect oscillation.
fields.coupling.electrical_tolerance_fraction: Numerical or physical acceptance tolerance for electrical fraction.
fields.boundaries.left.type: Selects the geometry, boundary, contact, or model type.
fields.boundaries.right.type: Selects the geometry, boundary, contact, or model type.
fields.boundaries.top.type: Selects the geometry, boundary, contact, or model type.
fields.boundaries.bottom.type: Selects the geometry, boundary, contact, or model type.
fields.tdgl_boundaries.left.type: Selects the geometry, boundary, contact, or model type.
fields.tdgl_boundaries.right.type: Selects the geometry, boundary, contact, or model type.
fields.tdgl_boundaries.top.type: Selects the geometry, boundary, contact, or model type.
fields.tdgl_boundaries.bottom.type: Selects the geometry, boundary, contact, or model type.
